title: Pineapple, Ginger and Coriander Ice Pops
changes_from_base: Fresh pineapple juice with pressed coriander-stem and ginger juices replaces the strawberry purée; no sugar or jam is added.
summary: A refreshing pineapple ice pop lifted with fresh ginger and a grassy hit of coriander.

ingredients.item: large bunch fresh coriander with stems and roots, rinsed

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Cut the stems from the coriander leaves, keeping the leaves for another dish, then finely chop the stems and roots in a food processor.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Press the chopped coriander through a fine sieve into a jug to give about 1 tbsp juice.

steps.title: Grate
steps.text: Grate the ginger into the sieve, press through, and add about 1 tsp ginger juice to the jug.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pour into six 80 ml moulds, add the sticks and freeze until solid, at least 6 h.

tips: Keep the coriander leaves back for another dish, since only the stems and roots go into these pops.
Press the coriander and ginger firmly through the sieve to squeeze out as much juice as possible.
Use fresh pineapple juice for the best, brightest flavour.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer.
